title: Alginate-based 3D cancer cell culture for therapeutic response modeling
protocol: Weigh out 1 g of resazurin sodium salt.
Pour 400 mL of pre-warmed RPMI culture media into a vacuum filtration bottle containing a stir bar.
Add the resazurin sodium salt into the culture media slowly.
Cover the bottle with aluminum foil to protect it from light.
Allow it to mix for 1 h on the stirrer.
Filter the resazurin using another vacuum filtration bottle.
Store the stock in 4°C protected from light for up to one month.
Dilute 4 mL of pre-warmed resazurin stock with 6 mL of serum-free pre-warmed RPMI culture media.
Add resazurin at a 1:10 ratio (15 μL per well of 150 μL culture media) to each well of the 96-well plate containing alginate beads.
Protect the plates from light by wrapping them in aluminum foil.
Place the plates on an orbital shaker at low speed for 5 min.
Incubate plates for 4 h at 37°C.
Measure fluorescence: 555 nm excitation/585 nm emission.
Aspirate the resazurin with a multichannel pipette after reading the plates.
Wash the plates with PBS twice for 5 min.
Aspirate PBS and replace it with fresh culture media.
Place the plates at 37°C if further proliferation measurement is required.
Thaw and warm the CTG reagent.
Add CTG reagent at a 1:3 ratio (50 μL per well of 150 μL culture media) to each well of the 96-well plate containing alginate beads using a multichannel pipette.
Place the plates on a shaker at low speed for 30 minutes in 20°C.
Measure luminescence by a luminescence plate reader compatible with CTG-based assay.
Discard the plates after reading.
Re-plate beads containing 2,500, 5,000, and 10,000 cells as well as empty beads into each well of a 96-well plate.
Add 200 μL of culture media to each well.
Use six replicates for each cell density including DMSO control.
Grow cells in 3D for 24 hours and then again for another 72 hours until larger colonies form.
Administer staurosporine at a concentration of 1 μM to cells in 3D alginate culture using a dispensing method.
Culture KP1N cells in alginate at concentrations of 2500, 5000, and 10000 cells per bead for 24 hours.
Culture KP1N cells further for 72 hours after the initial 24-hour period.
Treat cultured cells with staurosporine (1 μM) or DMSO for 48 hours.
Perform resazurin and CTG assays after treatment to assess cell viability and proliferation capacity.
Compare assay results of treated cells with untreated controls.
Normalize the results from resazurin and CTG assays to the reading for negative control (empty beads).
Analyze the normalized results in GraphPad Prism software.
Thaw the assay dyes.
Dilute stock of 4 mM calcein-AM to 2 μM.
Dilute stock of 2 mM ethidium homodimer-1 to 3 μM.
Dilute stock of 16.2 mM Hoechst to 33 μM in the culture media.
Aspirate the culture media from each well containing alginate beads using a multichannel pipette.
Add 150 mL of the prepared solution to each well.
Incubate the cells at 37°C for 2 h.
Image the plates with ImageXpress (or any other fluorescence microscope) using specified settings.
Discard the plates after imaging.
Prepare a stock concentration for each experimental drug, typically at 10 mM or 5 mM.
Add drugs to beads at final desired doses.
Place the plates on an orbital shaker at low speed for 5 minutes.
Incubate the plates at 37°C.
Read the plates using the resazurin assay at the end of the time-point.
Seed cells in 96-well plates for 2D experiments.
Culture cells until they reach a proliferation rate of at least 4 times their Day 1 seeding on Day 4.
Cultivate some cell lines in 3D cultures at higher densities and for longer periods to match the proliferation rate of 2D cultures on Day 4.
Plate beads in 96-well plates with 5–10 replicates per condition on Day 1.
Irradiate plates, except for the control plate, on Day 1.
Read the control plate using the resazurin assay on Day 1.
Measure cell viability and read all plates over time using the resazurin assay.
Add UltraPure™ 0.5M EDTA in a 1:5 ratio to the culture media containing beads.
Incubate for 5 minutes at 20°C.
Aspirate the solution using a serological pipette.
Centrifuge the sample at 150 g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the culture media and resuspend the cell pellet in PBS.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 150 g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate PBS and use the cell pellet for downstream experiments.
Label tubes accordingly.
Add lysis buffer to the cell pellet on ice for 20 minutes.
Centrifuge the lysate solution at 16,000 g for 15 minutes in a 4°C environment.
Transfer the supernatant into a new tube and store at -80°C.
